newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares gain in recovery from Monday's drop.
newsitem.headline: German shares gain in recovery from Monday's drop.

text.p: German shares were higher in early IBIS computer dealings on Tuesday as the firmer dollar helped the market rebound from Monday's losses.
The IBIS DAX, which reflects all-day computer trade, was up 21.07 points at 3,787.96 points and equal with the DAX's level at the end of bourse trade on Monday at 3,785.77 points.
"There's a good potential for the market to keep up this recovery," said one Frankfurt trader, noting that the dollar was trading above 1.74 marks in European dealings.
Others said the losses on Monday, tied to the drop on Wall Street, did not signal a change in the market's upward trend.

They said the DAX would seek to reach 3,800 points this week and stabilise above the psychologically-important level that was broken last week when the DAX reached a new high in IBIS computer trading at 3,836.91 points.
But any further advances would be dependent on trading volumes, which were weak on Monday as the second quarter ended.
Chemical and carmaker shares, which benefit from the weak mark helping exports, were leading the advance.
Hoechst AG, Bayer AG and BASF AG were all higher on news that CSFB had upgraded Hoechst to buy from hold and saw its share price rising to about 90 marks.

Hoechst gained 2.47 marks to 76.37 marks, while Bayer was up one mark at 68.50 marks and BASF was up 1.10 marks at 64.60 marks. strong gains, rising 100 marks to 1,450 marks, or a rise of about four percent.

Fellow luxury carmaker BMW AG was up 18 marks at 1,440 marks, outpacing the gains in the DAX index. Volkswagen AG was up 6.50 marks at 1,328.50 marks, while Daimler-Benz AG, maker of Mercedes vehicles, was up 60 pfennigs at 141.20 marks.

Market attention during bourse dealings will also focus on trading in software group Betasystems, the share price of which more than doubled on Monday from its initial public offering price of 100 marks to end the session at 206 marks.
